currentRepair.scope: Five WebKit fixture query failures in review, Positioner and detached handles; not closure of the large missing/partial source-body inventory.
currentRepair.cause: Canonical VoiceOver/WebKit FocusGuard uses role=button without aria-hidden. Unnamed getByRole(button) queries incorrectly selected all guards alongside the authored Toggle.
currentRepair.fix: Name the actual Toggle in custom-rendered ID, registered payload identity and anchor geometry queries. All existing ID, identity, geometry, exact offsets, scrolling and collision assertions unchanged. No production/guard accessibility edits.
currentRepair.verification: Popover.review21, Positioner.browser6 and detached Root12 tests pass WebKit with0 failures/skips/unhandled; final complete lanes include corrected queries.

review: Manual file-by-file body comparison; source registrations are not credited by title or inventory-test presence. Matrices below enumerate concrete parameters; each row applies separately to every listed parameter unless its mapping specifies otherwise. Matched means authored assertion parity, not a passing execution claim.

defaults.missingEvidence: No equivalent complete interaction/assertion body in the inspected target family. Target-only policy or inventory assertions do not satisfy the source case.

rootOpen.title: opens, labels, closes and rewires dismissal after reopening (detached=${detached})
rootOpen.body: Click Toggle; assert dialog accessible name/description and exact title/description IDs and aria-controls; Escape removes dialog; reopen; Close removes dialog. No outside-body click, no third trigger, no Toggle second-click close.
